on.description: Config `claude.carryTrust` (spec §3.43): before sideby starts an interactive Claude session, an account that does not trust the folder gets the trust another Claude account already gave it.

account.description: The account that got the trust mark.

path.description: The folder the mark is for, as sideby wrote it.

from.description: The account whose trust was copied.

carried.description: The marks sideby copied and `sideby trust undo` can take back, oldest first.

dir.description: The folder asked about (its real path); only while on. Nothing is read while off.

kind.description: `git`: trust is kept for the main checkout `path`; `folder`: the folder or a parent counts; `unclear`: sideby cannot tell from the files and copies nothing.

root.description: Where Claude Code looks trust up for the folder; only while on.

trusts.description: Whether this account trusts the folder; absent when sideby cannot tell (`problem`).

problem.description: Why its .claude.json cannot be read; names the path only.

carryFrom.description: Starting this account here copies the trust of this account.

accounts.description: Each Claude account and its trust of the folder (booleans only); only while on.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
